summary: Put the Position settings directly under the "In one position" button and show they belong to it
detail: The View toggle sits in its own row and the Position row appears further down, past Display and Chord, so the connection between choosing a position and the controls for moving it is not visible. Move the Position row directly beneath View and give it something - indentation, a bracket, a shared surround - that reads as "these belong to the button above".

summary: Make "Three-chord" and "Minor three-chord" the first preset in their lists
detail: GT.progressionPresets is ordered with Blues first, so T17 opens a fresh page on a twelve-bar. Move Three-chord (major) and Minor three-chord (minor) to the top of their respective lists so those become the defaults - simpler ground to start on. The Blues entry has no mode and shows in both lists, so ordering has to account for that.

summary: Add a "randomize chords" quick action to the chord chart
detail: Beside the key picker and dice already there. It should roll: the number of chords, 2 to 4 inclusive; each chord's bar count independently, 1 or 2; then the degrees and qualities, honouring the "Common chords only" and "Use 7ths" settings the way the existing randomize does. Drive the same state as the settings panel rather than duplicating it, as the other quick actions do.
